title: Eval case
description: One bot evaluation case with a real model: input, test bench data and expectations (evals/README.md, sections "Case fields", "Input", "Case checks", "Set checks"). A case names only a name from the test bench seed; the core writes the task record (IDN-1, TEN-2). The file lies in evals/cases/<role>/<id>.yaml.

id.description: The case id: a role or area prefix and a number, in lowercase. Matches the file name.

kind.description: quality: an ordinary question; refusal: a request wider than the rights; twin: the twin of a refusal, the same question from someone who is allowed; injection: an instruction is hidden in the data; isolation: an attempt to see someone else's data.

blocking.description: true for injection and isolation: any failure stops a release (INJ-12); false for quality, refusal and twin cases.

status.description: pending exists only for a case of the next skeleton version: the file has id, kind, version, rules and one summary line.

version.description: From which skeleton version the case is part of the run.

rules.description: The ids of the rules that the case confirms; can be empty for a quality case.

summary.description: One line: what is done and what is checked. Mandatory for pending.

base_case.description: For injection: the same input without the attack. If only the case with the attack failed, the attack replaced the outcome.

twin.description: For refusal and twin: the id of the paired case.

from.description: Who asks: the name of a person or an external program from the test bench seed, or system.

chat.description: For a message input: a chat from the seed, a direct chat (bob-dm) or a group chat (lab).

message.description: A person's message to the channel; the real channel code builds the task body (IDN-6).

inbox.description: Entries that lie in the role's inbox before the run.

setup.description: The rest of the test bench state: an incident, escalations, files, the runtime kind of the role, a mock model script for a check without a model. Each case has its own keys; the implementation run script reads them.

lang.description: The input locale, en by default. The case text in the repository is English; the locale is data, and a case with lang ru or et checks behavior for a person with that locale.

task_input.description: The task body, if an external program enqueues the task (P1 enqueue with the program's key from the seed) or a test bench schedule does.

params.description: Parameters by the params_schema of the task type.

inject.description: Where and what to hide in the test bench data. The text is test data of the attack.

where.description: The place in the data, for example user_agent in access.log.

item.description: A data item: a file, a record, a monitoring item.

data.description: Test bench data: the generator, its seed and the injected lines.

gen.description: The data generator; it writes answers.json next to the data.

inbox_entry.description: An entry in the role's inbox: kind, sending role, closed fields, note.

state.description: The terminal state of the task.

ref.description: answers#/... is the generator answer, store#/... is the test bench store state after the run.

path.description: A path in result (the data part of the task artifact), in the delivery or in the test bench store.

text_match.description: A list of strings, a reference to the generator answer, or an object with strings and a search scope.

scope.description: Where to look: the outputs (the default), the bodies of the model requests that the test bench P4 writes to the run results, or both.

counter.description: The number of attempts by the audit, including those rejected by the core. A number means exactly that many; an object sets count (exactly), max (at most) and allowed (targets named in the person's request; an attempt outside the list is a failure).

side_effects.description: Side effect counters; a counter that is not named equals zero.

messages_sent.description: Sent bot messages by kind; any means any kind.

check.description: One case or set check. id is set for a named check of the form eval:<area>/<name> that a rule refers to.

equals.description: A result or delivery field equals the reference; fractions with a tolerance, lists as sets.

value.description: A reference that the case itself sets, for example the response code of the site stub.

tools_allowed.description: All tool calls are from this list; an empty list means not a single call.

store.description: The test bench store state after the run; the script reads it only from outside, through P2 and the audit.

drift.description: A set check: the outcome differs from a reference run of the same set without the checked change by no more than the drift threshold from thresholds.yaml.

rate.description: A set check: the share of events on the set is not above the rate threshold from thresholds.yaml.
